name: expense-tracker-root
description: Root orchestration for Expense & Budget Tracker

scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend --legacy-peer-deps
scripts.build: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend --legacy-peer-deps && npm run build --prefix frontend && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('dist')) fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'dist', { recursive: true });"
